name: Doctoral Program in Neurobiology and Behavior (NB&B)
detailsNote: Official information available. The program's page shows 'December 1' without a year, so the deadline is not confirmed for Fall 2027.
summary: Columbia doctoral program in neurobiology and behavior. Entering students do a series of lab rotations and work with the program co-directors.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published application submission deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Official page gives this date without a year; not confirmed for Fall 2027. Confirm the Fall 2027 date with the program.

timeline.interviews: Applicants selected for interviews are invited to one of two scheduled Open House events, where they interview with 5 faculty members.

english.note: Scores must be under two years old. Exemptions for a degree from an institution in a country where English is the sole official language, and case-by-case waivers where the language of instruction was English.

applicationFee.note: Fee for the 2027 online application. Waivers are for financial need or hardship, research pathways programs, outside fellowship organizations and US military service; the page does not limit them by citizenship, but confirm eligibility.

documents: Letters of recommendation (from research advisors are especially helpful)
requirements.note: No paper applications. Applicants must submit all materials directly, without an agent or third-party vendor.

funding.note: Students making progress toward their degree are 'guaranteed to receive full financial support covering tuition and fees plus a stipend for living expenses.' No amount or year is given.

sources.label: Columbia GSAS: Information for international applicants
